tools.name: noxgild_devices
tools.description: List this account's authorized Noxgild computers and their authoritative online/worker health state.

tools.name: noxgild_approve
tools.description: Explicitly approve one queued very destructive or untrusted cross-layer command after reviewing its exact command ID, capability, and arguments. This authorization applies only to that command.

tools.name: noxgild_command
tools.description: Read the authoritative status/result of a Noxgild command.

tools.name: noxgild_wait
tools.description: Wait up to 25 seconds for an existing Noxgild command to complete, fail, cancel, or enter UNKNOWN.

tools.name: noxgild_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a Noxgild command when cancellation is still possible.

tools.name: noxgild_wake
tools.description: Wake an offline Noxgild computer using an online Noxgild helper on the same LAN. The target BIOS/NIC must support Wake-on-LAN.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: noxgild_browser_console, noxgild_cloud_browser_console · Private data: noxgild_machine_files_read, noxgild_machine_files_list, noxgild_machine_files_write, noxgild_machine_files_search, noxgild_machine_files_patch, noxgild_machine_files_copy, noxgild_machine_files_move, noxgild_machine_files_delete, noxgild_machine_files_info, noxgild_machine_files_hash, noxgild_machine_files_exists, noxgild_machine_files_tree, noxgild_machine_files_append, noxgild_machine_files_read_range, noxgild_machine_files_tail, noxgild_machine_files_watch, noxgild_browser_file_upload, noxgild_desktop_file_dialog, noxgild_cloud_browser_file_upload · Public sink: noxgild_machine_process_input, noxgild_browser_file_upload, noxgild_cloud_browser_file_upload · Destructive: noxgild_machine_process_terminate, noxgild_machine_files_delete, noxgild_machine_shell_run.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: noxgild_browser_console, noxgild_cloud_browser_console · Private data: noxgild_machine_files_read, noxgild_machine_files_list, noxgild_machine_files_write, noxgild_machine_files_search, noxgild_machine_files_patch, noxgild_machine_files_copy, noxgild_machine_files_move, noxgild_machine_files_delete, noxgild_machine_files_info, noxgild_machine_files_hash, noxgild_machine_files_exists, noxgild_machine_files_tree, noxgild_machine_files_append, noxgild_machine_files_read_range, noxgild_machine_files_tail, noxgild_machine_files_watch, noxgild_browser_file_upload, noxgild_desktop_file_dialog, noxgild_cloud_browser_file_upload · Public sink: noxgild_machine_process_input, noxgild_browser_file_upload, noxgild_cloud_browser_file_upload · Destructive: noxgild_machine_process_terminate, noxgild_machine_files_delete, noxgild_machine_shell_run

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
